coverage: Default SV/MV snapshot resolution excludes RMBG-2.0
Pipeline configuration clears even a preexisting matting-model path by default
Disabled adapter never constructs matting weights during CUDA/CPU movement or accidental calls
Explicit adapter defers construction until first actual use and retains upstream offload semantics
Temporary upstream factory replacement is restored on successful and failed initialization
Pinned original from_pretrained and RGBA preprocess_image method bodies run with tiny model/sampler doubles, without matting weights
HTTP and administrative paths reject removal before admission/downloads unless the operator explicitly enables it
Default CLI, benchmark and HTTP acceptance requests opt out of matting

limits: Default images must already be framed/prepared; no automatic background segmentation or crop is performed
Reference/optimized quality and speed are not established by these checks
Other model licenses and full-service commercial clearance are not assessed here
No other matting provider is silently substituted
